The owner stopped further model testing in that session after the owner-reported Gemini 3.1 Pro quota exhaustion and automatic UI fallback to Gemini 3.5 Flash; no clean standalone Flash run was completed, and the session did not establish a permanent abandonment of synthetic evaluation or select a new canonical evaluation direction. Pass 2 observations remain: the current Expert Memory stack self-corrected several Router errors but retained source-clause drift, unresolved security-instrument attribute leakage and an invalid graph reference. Exact model/version continuity, unresolved-instance consistency, valid relation endpoints and clean baseline-versus-taught separation remain required evaluation controls. The previously approved synthetic blind evaluation from PR #315 is restored as the canonical next step, to be resumed only if and when the owner chooses to restart model testing.
